caveats: AUC~AS association is observational across cancer cell lines; it is not evidence of mechanism and not evidence of benefit in a non-cancer context.

PRISM lines are tumour cell lines, not a child's tissues; aneuploidy here is arm-level somatic copy-number load, which is related to - but not identical to - the mosaic whole-chromosome aneuploidy of MVA.
Lineage fixed effects absorb coarse tissue-of-origin confounding only; growth rate, ploidy and mutation background can still confound.

Phase field is the Broad Repurposing Hub annotation shipped with PRISM 19Q4; 'Launched' means marketed somewhere for some indication and is cross-checked against ChEMBL/DrugCentral/openFDA by the engine lane before any claim is made.
Screen choice follows the PRISM readme (MTS010 redos preferred when present); no r2/convergence filter beyond valid AUC.
